worldcombat.skill.bodypress.summary: Drop your centre of gravity, brace your shoulder and drive your whole armoured body forward in a chosen direction. On contact you stop and keep pushing, shoving the target along; when it cannot move you settle at once instead of grinding. You can pick a direction and press into empty space. The higher your Defence, the harder it hits and the further it shoves.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.use.0: Shove a blocking foe aside in any direction with armour and weight
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.use.1: Push a target out of cover or off a ledge
The shove deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Available after %1$s seconds of bracing; it drives up to %2$s blocks along your aim at %3$s blocks per tick.

On contact it drives the target about %1$s blocks along the push; grinding keeps pace and follows through over about %2$s, while the hard-stop form shoves almost at once. When the target hits an obstacle or cannot be moved, it settles into a brief compress instead of grinding on; the plough mark only extends by the distance actually pushed, and the main damage was already settled on contact from Defence.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.grind.on: Grinding form: the impact becomes a longer sustained push that shoves much further, but each hit is lighter and the recovery and cooldown are longer.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.grind.off: Hard-stop form: a heavier single hit that shoves almost at once, but the push is short and it controls less ground.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.growth.0: At level %1$s, the shove power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.growth.1: At level %1$s, the shove power rises to %2$s and the push distance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.preference.g: On: the impact becomes a longer sustained push that shoves much further, but each hit is lighter and the recovery and cooldown are longer. Off: the hard-stop form, a heavier single hit pushed almost at once.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of pressing. Larger values chase harder, and are easier to kite before the brace lands.
Below this fraction of health it will not start a press unless the target is nearly finished. Higher values are more protective and brace less while low.
